context.passage:
Pro Clean Dry Cleaners
Count the ways we work to serve you!
1. Customer drop-off 24 hours a day through our drop box
2. Expert stain removal using the most up-to-date cleaning
equipment and solutions
3. Tailoring services, including button and zipper replacement
4. Long-term on-site garment storage
Monthly special: During the month of March, first-time customers get
30 percent off their dry-cleaning service, plus a free garment bag! Watch
our mailings for future discounts.
